title: secp256k1
summary: The elliptic curve digital signature algorithm used by Bitcoin and Ethereum, supported in SORA Nexus for legacy interoperability. While Ed25519 is the default signature scheme, secp256k1 support enables compatibility with existing blockchain wallets and applications that depend on this standard.
